In this notebook, I will create plots for supplemental figure 1

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)


thisseed <- 231103

ct.colors <- c('#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c', '#d62728', '#9467bd', '#8c564b',
       '#e377c2', '#7f7f7f', '#bcbd22', '#17becf')

edgeColVec <- c(
  "transparent" = "#ffffff",
  "present" = "#000000",
  "A" = ct.colors[1],
  "B" = ct.colors[2],
  "C" = ct.colors[3],
  "D" = ct.colors[4],
  "E" = ct.colors[5],
  "F" = ct.colors[6],
  "G" = ct.colors[7],
  "H" = ct.colors[8],
  "I" = ct.colors[9],
  "J" = ct.colors[10]
  )

colEPI <- "#7FC97F"
colLP <- "#FDC086"

extendNum <- 4
finalCol <- "gray100"
```

```{r}
obs <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_allcells_obs.rds")
obs
```

# Epithelium and Lamina Propria Fractions

```{r}
idsEPI <- obs %>% filter(layer == "EPI") %>% pull(sample) %>% unique
colsEPI <- colorRampPalette(colors = c(finalCol,colEPI))(
    length(idsEPI) + extendNum
)
colsEPI <- colsEPI[(extendNum+1):length(colsEPI)]
names(colsEPI) <- idsEPI
colsEPI

idsLP <- obs %>% filter(layer == "LP") %>% pull(sample) %>% unique
colsLP <- colorRampPalette(colors = c(finalCol,colLP))(
    length(idsLP) + extendNum
)
colsLP <- colsLP[(extendNum+1):length(colsLP)]
names(colsLP) <- idsLP
colsLP
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=24}
ggplot(obs, aes(y = cellstate)) + 
  geom_bar(aes(fill = fct_relevel(sample, c(names(colsEPI), names(colsLP) ))),
    position="fill", color = "black", linewidth=0.25, show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(colsEPI, colsLP)) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_col(data = data.frame(layer = fct_inorder(c("Lamina Propria", "Epithelium"))),
           aes(x = 0, y = 0, fill = layer), color = "black",
           alpha = 0, lwd = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Epithelium" = colEPI, "Lamina Propria" = colLP),
                    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 10, alpha = 1, lwd = 2, color = "black"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent(c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1))) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  facet_grid(celltype ~ ., 
             scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  theme_light() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top", 
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust=0.30),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 1, color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.25, 0.75, 0.25, 0.25), "cm")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Percentage of Cells",
    y = "Cellstate",
    fill = "Biopsy Fraction"
  ) 
```



```{r}
cellstate.cellsubtype.assignments <- obs.unique %>% pull(cellsubtype, cellstate)
cellstate.cellsubtype.assignments
```

```{r}
cellstate.celltype.assignments <- obs.unique %>% pull(celltype, cellstate)
# cellstate.celltype.assignments
# 
cellsubtype.celltype.assignments <- obs.unique %>% pull(celltype, cellsubtype)
# cellsubtype.celltype.assignments
# 
celltype.celltype.assignments <- obs.unique %>% pull(celltype, celltype)
# celltype.celltype.assignments

all.celltype.assignments <- c(celltype.celltype.assignments, cellsubtype.celltype.assignments, cellstate.celltype.assignments)
all.celltype.assignments
```


```{r}
obs.unique.prop <- obs %>% 
  mutate(root = as.factor("PREDICT")) %>%  
  add_count(celltype, name = "celltype.n") %>% 
  add_count(cellsubtype, name = "cellsubtype.n") %>% 
  add_count(cellstate, name = "cellstate.n") %>% 
  mutate(celltype.prop = celltype.n/n()) %>% 
  mutate(cellsubtype.prop = cellsubtype.n/celltype.n) %>% 
  mutate(cellstate.prop = cellstate.n/cellsubtype.n) %>% 
  distinct(root, celltype, cellsubtype, cellstate, celltype.prop, cellsubtype.prop, cellstate.prop)
obs.unique.prop
```

```{r}
edges.01.prop <- obs.unique.prop %>% 
  select(root, celltype, celltype.prop) %>% 
  unique %>% 
  rename(from=root, to=celltype, prop=celltype.prop) %>% 
  mutate(celltype = to) %>%  
  mutate(edgecol = "transparent")

edges.01.prop %>% arrange(from, to)

edges.12.prop <- obs.unique.prop %>% 
  select(celltype, cellsubtype, cellsubtype.prop) %>% 
  unique %>% 
  rename(from=celltype, to=cellsubtype, prop=cellsubtype.prop) %>% 
  mutate(celltype = from) %>%
  # mutate(edgecol = "present")
  mutate(edgecol = mapcol[to])

edges.12.prop %>% arrange(from, to)

edges.23.prop <- obs.unique.prop %>% 
  select(cellsubtype, cellstate, celltype, cellstate.prop) %>% 
  unique %>% 
  rename(from=cellsubtype, to=cellstate, prop=cellstate.prop) %>% 
  mutate(edgecol = mapcol[from])

edges.23.prop %>% arrange(from, to)

edge.df.prop <- rbind(
  edges.01.prop %>% arrange(from, to),
  edges.12.prop %>% arrange(from, to),
  edges.23.prop %>% arrange(from, to)
  )
edge.df.prop
```

```{r}
cs.igraph.prop <- edge.df.prop %>% 
  mutate(from = fct_rev(from)) %>%
  mutate(to = fct_rev(to)) %>%
  arrange(from, to) %>% 
  mutate(to = ifelse(from %in% cellsubtypes & (as.character(from) == as.character(to)), # to handle duplicate cell types and states
                     paste0(as.character(to), "_CS"),
                     as.character(to))
         ) %>% 
  as_tbl_graph() %>% 
  activate("nodes") %>% 
  mutate(nodecol = case_when(
    name == "PREDICT" ~ "transparent",
    name %in% celltypes ~ "present",
    name %in% cellsubtypes ~ mapcol[name],
    str_remove(name, "_CS") %in% cellstates ~ mapcol[cellstate.cellsubtype.assignments[str_remove(name, "_CS")]]
  ))

cs.igraph.prop
```


```{r, fig.width=40, fig.height=10}
cs.igraph.prop %>% 
  activate("nodes") %>% 
  mutate(textsize = case_when(
    name %in% celltypes ~ "large",
    name %in% cellsubtypes ~ "medium",
    name %in% cellstates ~ "small",
    str_detect(name, "_CS") ~ "small"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, "_CS")) %>% 
  mutate(celltype = fct_rev(all.celltype.assignments)[name]) %>% 
  ggraph(layout = 'dendrogram') + 
  geom_edge_elbow(aes(color = edgecol, width = prop)) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = edgeColVec) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(1,8)) +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = name, size = textsize, color = nodecol), fontface = "bold", angle = -90, alpha = 1, label.size = 2, label.padding = unit(0.125, "lines")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = edgeColVec) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale("color") +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = name, size = textsize), color = "black", fontface = "bold", angle = -90, alpha = 1, label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.125, "lines")) +
  facet_graph(~celltype, row_type = "node", col_type = "node", scales = "free", space = "free") +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("large" = 12, "medium" = 9.5,  "small" = 8.5)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = unit(c(0,-0.2,2.5,-0.6), "cm"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.75, "cm")
    )
```
